        ss.abor_security_type_name,
        ss.abor_instrument_type_id,
        ss.investment_type_name,

        rec.country_ref_code,

        rcc_incorp_country.country_name AS esm_incorp_country_name,
        sp.portfolio_group_id,
        sp.portfolio_name,

        spif.investmentstructurelevel4

    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM asset.enterprise_security
    ) es ON st.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id AND es.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio smp 
        ON smp.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio)
        AND st.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scd_party_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM party.enterprise_party
    ) ep ON st.counterparty_id = ep.scd_party_id AND ep.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_securities ss 
        ON st.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
        AND ss.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_securities)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_exchange_codes rec 
        ON es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
        AND rec.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_exchange_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_exchange_country 
        ON es.esm_country_code = rcc_exchange_country.country_code
        AND rcc_exchange_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country 
        ON es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
        AND rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY portfolio_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS latest
        FROM reference.scd_portfolio
    ) sp ON sp.latest = 1 AND sp.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_trade_country 
        ON rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
        AND rcc_trade_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            abor_transaction_number,
            business_date,
            transaction_cancellation_flag,
            trade_date,
            abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
            amount_quotation_currency AS other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
            abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
            amount_portfolio_currency AS other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_quotation_currency ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_settlement_currency ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) AS restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_quotation_currency ELSE 0 END) AS restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_settlement_currency ELSE 0 END) AS restitution_expected_settlement_currency,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY abor_transaction_number
                ORDER BY business_date DESC
            ) AS latest
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transaction_cost
        WHERE transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
    ) stc
    ON stc.latest = 1
       AND st.abor_transaction_number = stc.abor_transaction_number
       AND st.transaction_cancellation_flag = stc.transaction_cancellation_flag
       AND st.trade_date = stc.trade_date
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id, portfolio_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main
    ) shm ON shm.abor_security_id = st.abor_security_id
        AND shm.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
        AND shm.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes rcc 
        ON st.quotation_currency = rcc.currency_code
        AND rcc.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_currency_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY model_portfolio ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
    ) spif
        ON spif.model_portfolio = st.model_portfolio_id
        AND spif.rn = 1
)
-- ✅ Final deduplication after joins
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
               ORDER BY business_date DESC, abor_transaction_number, trade_date, created_date
           ) AS final_rank
    FROM JoinedData
    WHERE rn = 1
) deduped
WHERE final_rank = 1) AS "transactions_base"
LIMIT 1000

    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio smp 
        ON smp.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio)
        AND st.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scd_party_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM party.enterprise_party
    ) ep ON st.counterparty_id = ep.scd_party_id AND ep.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_securities ss

        AND ss.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_securities)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_exchange_codes rec

    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_exchange_country

        AND rcc_exchange_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)

       AND st.abor_transaction_number = stc.abor_transaction_number
       AND st.transaction_cancellation_flag = stc.transaction_cancellation_flag
       AND st.trade_date = stc.trade_date

        FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main
    ) shm ON shm.abor_security_id = st.abor_security_id

SELECT "hierarchy_node" AS "69e79e97-1b91-47fa-9fc6-9dc9013f5c6d.hierarchy_node", "business_date" AS "69e79e97-1b91-47fa-9fc6-9dc9013f5c6d.business_date", "fiscal_quarter" AS "69e79e97-1b91-47fa-9fc6-9dc9013f5c6d.fiscal_quarter", "active_vol_10yr" AS "69e79e97-1b91-47fa-9fc6-9dc9013f5c6d.active_vol_10yr", "pv" AS "69e79e97-1b91-47fa-9fc6-9dc9013f5c6d.pv", "active_vol_number" AS "69e79e97-1b91-47fa-9fc6-9dc9013f5c6d.active_vol_number", "TenYr_Beta" AS "69e79e97-1b91-47fa-9fc6-9dc9013f5c6d.TenYr_Beta"
FROM (SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Real Assets~CORE' THEN 'Real Assets'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Real Estate~CORE' THEN 'Real Estate'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Infrastructure (P)~CORE' THEN 'Infrastructure'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Sustainable Energy Group~CORE' THEN 'Sustainable Energy Group'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Credit Investments~CORE' THEN 'Credit Investments'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Antares (P)~CORE' THEN 'Antares'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Active Credit ex. Antares~CORE' THEN 'Active Credit ex. Antares'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Private Equity~CORE' THEN 'Private Equity'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Funds & Secondaries~CORE' THEN 'Funds & Secondaries'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Direct Private Equity (S)~CORE' THEN 'Direct Private Equity'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Private Equity Asia~CORE' THEN 'Private Equity Asia'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Growth Equity (P)~CORE' THEN 'Growth Equity'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Listed Real Estate~CORE' THEN 'Listed Real Estate'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy PE Asia~CORE' THEN 'ISG PE Asia'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy Growth Equity~CORE' THEN 'ISG PE GE'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy DEILA~CORE' THEN 'ISG AE DEILA'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy FIG~CORE' THEN 'ISG PE FIG'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy Funds & Secondaries~CORE' THEN 'ISG PE F&S'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy SEG~CORE' THEN 'ISG RA SEG'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy AE Asia~CORE' THEN 'ISG AE Asia'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy Direct Private Equity~CORE' THEN 'ISG PE DPE'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy RE~CORE' THEN 'ISG RA RE'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy~CORE' THEN 'ISG Legacy'
        ELSE a.hierarchy_node
    END AS hierarchy_node,
    
    CAST(a.business_date AS DATE) AS business_date,

    -- Fiscal Quarter Tagging
    CASE
        WHEN a.business_date IN (
            SELECT MAX(business_date)
            FROM risk_prod.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_vol
            WHERE month(date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (3,6,9,12)
              AND date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') < date_trunc('month', current_date)
            GROUP BY year(date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')), month(date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d'))
        )
        THEN CASE
            WHEN month(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (4,5,6)
                THEN 'F' || substr(cast(year(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) + 1 AS varchar), 3, 2) || ' Q1'
            WHEN month(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (7,8,9)
                THEN 'F' || substr(cast(year(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) + 1 AS varchar), 3, 2) || ' Q2'
            WHEN month(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (10,11,12)
                THEN 'F' || substr(cast(year(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) + 1 AS varchar), 3, 2) || ' Q3'
            ELSE 'F' || substr(cast(year(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) AS varchar), 3, 2) || ' Q4'
        END
        ELSE NULL
    END AS fiscal_quarter,

    a.analytic_value AS active_vol_10yr,  
    b.pv, 
    CASE 
        WHEN b.pv IS NOT NULL AND b.pv != 0 THEN a.analytic_value / b.pv 
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS active_vol_number,
    
    TRY_CAST(beta.analytic_value AS DOUBLE) AS TenYr_Beta

FROM risk_prod.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_vol a

LEFT JOIN risk_prod.benchmark_analytic_pv b
    ON a.hierarchy_node = b.node_name
    AND CAST(b.business_date AS DATE) = CAST(a.business_date AS DATE)

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        c.business_date, 
        c.analytic_value, 
        d.node_name
    FROM risk_prod.fact_analytic_md_rel_var c
    LEFT JOIN risk_prod.dim_hierarchy_node d
        ON d.dim_hierarchy_node_id = c.dim_hierarchy_node_id_1
        AND d.business_date = c.business_date
    WHERE c.portfolio_type_2 = 'SAP CORE'
      AND c.analytic_name = '10 Year Beta'
) beta
    ON a.hierarchy_node = beta.node_name
    AND CAST(beta.business_date AS DATE) = CAST(a.business_date AS DATE)

WHERE a.benchmark_name = 'SAP CORE'
  AND a.analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR'
  AND a.hierarchy_node IN (
      'Real Assets~CORE', 'Real Estate~CORE', 'Infrastructure (P)~CORE', 
      'Sustainable Energy Group~CORE', 'Credit Investments~CORE', 
      'Antares (P)~CORE', 'Active Credit ex. Antares~CORE', 
      'Private Equity~CORE', 'Funds & Secondaries~CORE', 
      'Direct Private Equity (S)~CORE', 'Private Equity Asia~CORE', 
      'Growth Equity (P)~CORE', 'Listed Real Estate~CORE', 'ISG Legacy PE Asia~CORE',
      'ISG Legacy Growth Equity~CORE','ISG Legacy DEILA~CORE','ISG Legacy FIG~CORE',
      'ISG Legacy Funds & Secondaries~CORE','ISG Legacy SEG~CORE','ISG Legacy AE Asia~CORE',
      'ISG Legacy Direct Private Equity~CORE','ISG Legacy~CORE','ISG Legacy RE~CORE'
  )
  AND CAST(a.business_date AS DATE) > DATE '2025-03-30') AS "Beta/AR"
LIMIT 1000

	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, case
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D' then 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D' then 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D' then 'Total Fund Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' then 'Base CPP Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD' then 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
			else pbor_node_name

		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'

		, case

			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'

			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency

			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'

			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'

			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )

WITH RankedSecurities AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM reference.scd_securities
    WHERE business_date = '2025-06-06'
)
select a.*, b.*, c.*, f.*, d.*, e.*, p.*
from
(
select 
  ss.model_portfolio_id as id_model_portfolio,
  ss.scd_holding_key_id as id_source_holding,
  null as id_enterprise_holding,
  ss.abor_security_name as security_name,
  ss.abor_security_number as security_no,
  ss.quotation_currency_code as currency,
  sec.abor_country_id as country_code,
  ss.abor_security_type_id as security_type_code,	   
  ss.abor_security_type_name as security_type_name,
  ss.security_group_id as security_group_code,	   
  ss.security_group_name,
  '48' as instrument_type_code,
  ss.abor_instrument_type as instrument_type_name,	   
  sec.country_of_exposure_code as exposure_country_code,
  sec.country_of_exposure_name as exposure_country_name,
  sec.currency_of_exposure_code as exposure_currency_code,
  sec.currency_of_exposure_name as exposure_currency_name,
  ss.balance_nominal_number as balance_nominal,	   
  ss.clean_price * ss.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency as clean_price_pc,
  cast(ss.clean_price as DECIMAL(18,2)) as clean_price_qc,
  ss.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency as balance_cost_value_qc,
  ss.balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency as balance_cost_value_pc,
  ss.balance_book_value_quotation_currency as balance_book_value_qc,
  ss.clean_value_quotation_currency as clean_value_qc,

from holdings.scd_holdings_main ss
left join RankedSecurities sec 
    on ss.scd_security_id = sec.scd_security_key_id
where ss.business_date = '2025-06-06'
and sec.rn = 1) as a

left join
(
  select
    concat(CAST(h.account_id AS varchar), '00', lpad(CAST(h.security_identifier AS varchar), 4, '0')) id_instrument,
    s.scd_id security_no,
    s.currency deal_local_currency,
    concat(s.security_name, ':', h.account_number) deal_name_source,
    h.model_portfolio_id id_model_portfolio,
    h.market_value_net_base carrying_value_base_cur_deal,
    h.market_value_net_local carrying_value_local_cur_deal,
    h.market_value_net_base carrying_value_inc_adj_base_cur,
    h.market_value_accrued_net_local carrying_value_inc_adj_local_cur,
    (CASE WHEN trim(i.country_of_exposure) = '' THEN '' ELSE UPPER(i.country_of_exposure) END) country_of_exposure,
    i.currency_of_exposure,
    0 as deal_commitment_amt_base_cur,
    0 as deal_commitment_amt_local_cur,
    i.developed_or_emerging,
    coalesce(cfh.distributions_itd_base, 0) distribution_itd_base_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.distributions_itd_local, 0) distribution_itd_local_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.distributions_qtd_base, 0) distribution_qtd_base_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.distributions_qtd_local, 0) distribution_qtd_local_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.distributions_ytd_base, 0) distribution_ytd_base_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.distributions_ytd_local, 0) distribution_ytd_local_cur,
    0 as dpi_base_itd,
    0 as dpi_local_itd,
    (CASE WHEN trim(s.ownership_pct) = '' THEN '0.00 %' ELSE concat(CAST(CAST(CAST(s.ownership_pct AS decimal(38,12)) * 100 AS decimal(10,2)) AS varchar), ' %') END) equity_ownership_percentage,
    i.region geographic_focus,
    i.gics_sector industry_focus,
    '0.0000000 %' as irr_percentage_base_itd,
    '0.0000000 %' as irr_percentage_local_itd,
    null as key_investment_style,
    0 as multiple_base_currency_itd,
    0 as multiple_local_currency_itd,
    coalesce(cfh.paid_in_itd_base, 0) paid_in_capital_itd_base_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.paid_in_itd_local, 0) paid_in_capital_itd_local_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.paid_in_qtd_base, 0) paid_in_capital_qtd_base_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.paid_in_qtd_local, 0) paid_in_capital_qtd_local_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.paid_in_ytd_base, 0) paid_in_capital_ytd_base_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.paid_in_ytd_local, 0) paid_in_capital_ytd_local_cur,
    s.reporting_name,
    s.ir_classification primary_investment_category,
    null as secondary_investment_category,
    null as segmentation,
    0 as unfunded_commitment_amt_base_cur,
    0 as unfunded_commitment_amt_local_cur,
    null as vintage_year
  from holdings.ci_sentry_holdings h
  join reference.ci_sentry_security s on h.security_identifier = s.security_identifier and h.business_date BETWEEN s.start_date and s.end_date
  join reference.ci_sentry_issuer i on s.issuer_identifier = i.issuer_identifier and h.business_date BETWEEN i.start_date and i.end_date
  left join (
    select
      business_date,
      security_identifier,
      account_id,
      hierarchy_group,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Distributions' then amount_local else 0 end) as distributions_itd_local,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Distributions' then amount_base else 0 end) as distributions_itd_base,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Paid-In' then amount_local else 0 end) as paid_in_itd_local,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Paid-In' then amount_base else 0 end) as paid_in_itd_base,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Distributions' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('quarter', date(business_date)) then amount_local else 0 end) as distributions_qtd_local,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Distributions' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('quarter', date(business_date)) then amount_base else 0 end) as distributions_qtd_base,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Paid-In' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('quarter', date(business_date)) then amount_local else 0 end) as paid_in_qtd_local,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Paid-In' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('quarter', date(business_date)) then amount_base else 0 end) as paid_in_qtd_base,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Distributions' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('year', date(business_date)) then amount_local else 0 end) as distributions_ytd_local,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Distributions' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('year', date(business_date)) then amount_base else 0 end) as distributions_ytd_base,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Paid-In' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('year', date(business_date)) then amount_local else 0 end) as paid_in_ytd_local,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Paid-In' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('year', date(business_date)) then amount_base else 0 end) as paid_in_ytd_base
    from trades_deals.ci_sentry_cashflows_hierarchy
    where hierarchy_group = 'Paid-In Distributions'
    group by
      business_date,
      security_identifier,
      account_id,
      hierarchy_group
  ) cfh on h.business_date = cfh.business_date and s.security_identifier = cfh.security_identifier and h.account_id = cfh.account_id
  where h.loan_contract_identifier IS NULL and h.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from
    holdings.ci_sentry_holdings where
    business_date <= '2025-06-06'
  )

  union

  select
    cast(investran_deal_id as varchar) as id_instrument,
    abor_security_id as security_no,
    deal_local_currency,

        st.scd_transaction_number_primary_key,
        cast(st.business_date as date) as business_date,
        round(st.abor_transaction_number) as abor_transaction_number,
        st.abor_security_id,
        st.abor_security_number,
        st.abor_security_name,
        st.model_portfolio_id,
        st.portfolio_id,
        st.business_transaction_code,
        st.settlement_currency,
        cast(st.trade_date as date) as trade_date,
        cast(st.payment_date as date) as payment_date,
        st.nominal,
        st.nominal_basis,
        st.elementary_transaction_code,
        st.interest_dividend_capital_event_quotation_currency,
        st.interest_dividend_capital_event_portfolio_currency,
        st.transaction_cancellation_flag,
        st.reconciliation_status,
        st.created_date,
        st.transaction_number_in_originating_system,
        st.payment_amount_quotation_currency,
        st.payment_amount_portfolio_currency,
        st.external_short_tag,
        st.settlement_date,
        st.settlement_location,
        st.quotation_currency,
        st.number_of_units,
        st.price AS price_qc,
        st.price * st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS price_pc,
        st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency,
        st.accrued_interest_portfolio_currency,
        st.accrued_interest_quotation_currency,
        st.current_value_portfolio_currency,
        st.current_value_quotation_currency,
        st.additional_payable_amount_portfolio_currency,
        st.additional_payable_amount_quotation_currency,
        st.ibor_reason,
        st.dividend_per_share,
        st.borrowing_account,
        st.rn,
        CASE 
            WHEN ss.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') AND st.abor_security_name LIKE '%CAD%' THEN 'Y'
            WHEN ss.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') THEN 'N'
        END AS cross_deal_indicator,
        -- From joins
        es.sedol,
        es.isin,
        es.cusip,
        es.esm_incorp_country_code,
        es.security_name_id,
        es.esm_country_code,
        es.cppib_country_of_exposure_name,
        es.cppib_currency_of_exposure_name,
        smp.sst_custody_account_code,
        smp.model_portfolio_name,
        smp.investment_strategy_name,
        smp.investment_department_name,
        ep.party_id,
        ep.epm_party_name,
        ss.abor_security_group_name,
        ss.abor_security_type_name,
        ss.abor_instrument_type_id,
        ss.investment_type_name,
        ss.abor_coupon_rate,
        rec.country_ref_code,
        rcc_exchange_country.country_name AS esm_country_name,
        rcc_incorp_country.country_name AS esm_incorp_country_name,
        sp.portfolio_group_id,
        sp.portfolio_name,
        sp.portfolio_group_name,
        rcc_trade_country.country_name AS country_ref_name,
        rcc.currency_name AS quotation_currency_name,
        stc.abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
        stc.other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
        stc.abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
        stc.other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
        stc.coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
        stc.coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
        stc.coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
        stc.restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
        stc.restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
        stc.restitution_expected_settlement_currency,
        shm.accrued_interest_portfolio_currency AS shm_accrued_interest_portfolio_currency,
        shm.accrued_interest_quotation_currency AS shm_accrued_interest_quotation_currency,
        spif.investmentstructurelevel3,
        spif.investmentstructurelevel4
    FROM RankedTransactions st
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM asset.enterprise_security
    ) es ON st.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id AND es.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio smp 
        ON smp.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio)
        AND st.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scd_party_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM party.enterprise_party
    ) ep ON st.counterparty_id = ep.scd_party_id AND ep.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_securities ss 
        ON st.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
        AND ss.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_securities)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_exchange_codes rec 
        ON es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
        AND rec.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_exchange_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_exchange_country 
        ON es.esm_country_code = rcc_exchange_country.country_code
        AND rcc_exchange_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country 
        ON es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
        AND rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY portfolio_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS latest
        FROM reference.scd_portfolio
    ) sp ON sp.latest = 1 AND sp.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_trade_country 
        ON rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
        AND rcc_trade_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            abor_transaction_number,
            business_date,
            transaction_cancellation_flag,
            trade_date,
            abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
            amount_quotation_currency AS other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
            abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
            amount_portfolio_currency AS other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_quotation_currency ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_settlement_currency ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) AS restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_quotation_currency ELSE 0 END) AS restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_settlement_currency ELSE 0 END) AS restitution_expected_settlement_currency,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY abor_transaction_number
                ORDER BY business_date DESC
            ) AS latest
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transaction_cost
        WHERE transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
    ) stc
    ON stc.latest = 1
       AND st.abor_transaction_number = stc.abor_transaction_number
       AND st.transaction_cancellation_flag = stc.transaction_cancellation_flag
       AND st.trade_date = stc.trade_date
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id, portfolio_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main
    ) shm ON shm.abor_security_id = st.abor_security_id
        AND shm.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
        AND shm.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes rcc 
        ON st.quotation_currency = rcc.currency_code
        AND rcc.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_currency_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY model_portfolio ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
    ) spif
        ON spif.model_portfolio = st.model_portfolio_id
        AND spif.rn = 1
)
-- ✅ Final deduplication after joins
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
               ORDER BY business_date DESC, abor_transaction_number, trade_date, created_date
           ) AS final_rank
    FROM JoinedData
    WHERE rn = 1
) deduped
WHERE final_rank = 1) AS "transactions_base"
LIMIT 1000

SELECT *
        FROM (
		    SELECT
		        currencyCode,
			    date,
			    MAX(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
				    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
				    grouped_usd,
				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_cad,
					COUNT(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (

								erd.exchange_rate AS currencyToUsdRate,
								erc.is_exchange_holiday_flag as holiday_flag

select 
exposure_currency, product_group, business_date, SUM(final_value + future_cash_flows_cad) final_exposure_currency_amount
from
(
SELECT business_date, position_key, data_source, exposure_currency, exposure_currency_amount, final_value, override_source, override_value, portfolio_type, local_currency, source_system_notional_local_ccy, source_system_pv_local_ccy, position_description, model_portfolio, 
investment_dept, investment_strategy, investment_program, investment_sub_program, product_type, product_group,

case WHEN override_source = 'OFFSET' then -1 else 1 end * coalesce(fcp.future_cash_flows_local,0) future_cash_flows_local,
case WHEN override_source = 'OFFSET' then -1 else 1 end * coalesce(fcp.future_cash_flows_cad,0) future_cash_flows_cad
FROM risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure 
left join
(SELECT
trade_id,
future_cashflows_currency,
SUM( future_cash_flows ) future_cash_flows_local,
SUM( future_cash_flows * fx_rate_quoted_in_cad ) future_cash_flows_cad
 FROM df_trusted_prod.murex_total_return_swap_trade_latest 
where business_date in (select MAX(business_date) from df_trusted_prod.murex_total_return_swap_trade_latest )
group by trade_id, future_cashflows_currency ) fcp ON 

CASE 
    WHEN risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure.position_key LIKE 'MX%' THEN SUBSTRING(risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure.position_key FROM 3)
	ELSE risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure.position_key
  END = fcp.trade_id and risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure.exposure_currency  = fcp.future_cashflows_currency

WHERE 
risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure.business_date IN ( select max(business_date) from risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure) and
risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure.investment_dept = 'Active Equities' and 
risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure.investment_strategy in ( 'Asia')


) risk_database
group by exposure_currency, product_group, business_date

order by exposure_currency, product_group, business_date

select 
exposure_currency, investment_program, business_date, SUM(final_value + future_cash_flows_cad) final_exposure_currency_amount
from
(
SELECT business_date, position_key, data_source, exposure_currency, exposure_currency_amount, final_value, override_source, override_value, portfolio_type, local_currency, source_system_notional_local_ccy, source_system_pv_local_ccy, position_description, model_portfolio, 
investment_dept, investment_strategy, investment_program, investment_sub_program, product_type, product_group,

case WHEN override_source = 'OFFSET' then -1 else 1 end * coalesce(fcp.future_cash_flows_local,0) future_cash_flows_local,
case WHEN override_source = 'OFFSET' then -1 else 1 end * coalesce(fcp.future_cash_flows_cad,0) future_cash_flows_cad
FROM risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure 
left join
(SELECT
trade_id,
future_cashflows_currency,
SUM( future_cash_flows ) future_cash_flows_local,
SUM( future_cash_flows * fx_rate_quoted_in_cad ) future_cash_flows_cad
 FROM df_trusted_prod.murex_total_return_swap_trade_latest 
where business_date in (select MAX(business_date) from df_trusted_prod.murex_total_return_swap_trade_latest )
group by trade_id, future_cashflows_currency ) fcp ON 

CASE 
    WHEN risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure.position_key LIKE 'MX%' THEN SUBSTRING(risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure.position_key FROM 3)
	ELSE risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure.position_key
  END = fcp.trade_id and risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure.exposure_currency  = fcp.future_cashflows_currency

risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure.business_date IN ( select max(business_date) from risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure) and
risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure.investment_dept = 'Active Equities' and 
risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure.investment_strategy in ( 'LatAm') and 
risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure.investment_program in ( 'Latin America Private Investments')


) risk_database
group by exposure_currency, investment_program, business_date

order by exposure_currency, investment_program, business_date

/* QuickSight 26a78d95-3b91-497b-af3c-70a051ef4f88 */
SELECT "id_model_portfolio", "InvestmentStructureLevel1", "InvestmentStructureLevel2", "from_date", "to_date", "from_date_total_market_value_pc", "to_date_total_market_value_pc"
FROM (/*
 * IDENTIFY UNMAPPED MPs IN HOLDINGS LOOKTHROUGH
 */	
select
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date
	, sum( from_date_total_market_value_pc ) as from_date_total_market_value_pc
	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc
from (
	select distinct
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
		, min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as from_date
		, max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as to_date
		, case 
			when mhl.business_date = min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end from_date_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.business_date = max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc 
		  end to_date_total_market_value_pc
	from 
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion
		and mhl.pool_name not in ( 'ACPP', 'BCPP' )
		and spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 is null
	order by 
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
)
group by 
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date) AS "finsights_control_holdings_unmapped_mp"

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 09
		AND hour between 09 and 10
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-09 09:33:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::3a2de9f8af87dc8604468c36b6739a17f0a8a06c252db69291d8e2c98af632d8 */
SELECT * from (
            SELECT from_currency as from_currency, 
                ROUND(case when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price else mid_price end, 8) as mid_price, 
                format_datetime(business_date, 'yyyyMMdd') as business_date
            FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
            WHERE from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD' and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot' and business_date = (select max(business_date) from refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr where source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot')
            UNION
            SELECT MainTable.to_currency as from_currency, 
                ROUND(case when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then MainTable.mid_price * CAD_Rate.mid_price else (1/MainTable.mid_price) * CAD_Rate.mid_price end, 8) as calc_mid_price, 
                format_datetime(MainTable.business_date, 'yyyyMMdd') as business_date
            FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr as MainTable
            Left Join ( 
                SELECT case when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price else mid_price end as mid_price, business_date
                FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr WHERE from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD' and business_date = (select max(business_date) from refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr where source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot') and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
            ) as CAD_Rate on MainTable.business_date = CAD_Rate.business_date
            WHERE MainTable.business_date = (select max(business_date) from refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr where source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot') and MainTable.from_currency = 'USD' and MainTable.mid_price != 0 and MainTable.source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
            order by business_date, from_currency )
    where from_currency = 'USD'

SELECT *
        FROM (
		    SELECT
		        currencyCode,
			    date,
			    MAX(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
				    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
				    grouped_usd,
				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_cad,
					COUNT(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_usd,
					date - LAG(date, 3) OVER(
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as data_diff
				FROM (
						SELECT erc.data_date AS date,
								erc.currency AS currencyCode,
								erc.exchange_rate AS currencyToCadRate,
								erd.exchange_rate AS currencyToUsdRate,
								erc.is_exchange_holiday_flag as holiday_flag
						FROM cppib_market_exchange_rate_cad erc
								LEFT JOIN cppib_market_exchange_rate erd
								ON erc.data_date = erd.data_date
								AND erc.vendor = erd.vendor
								AND erc.currency = erd.currency
							WHERE ((erc.vendor = 'wm' AND erc.currency != 'CLF')
							        OR (erc.vendor = 'tokyo' AND erc.currency = 'CLF'))
								AND erc.currency IN ('USD','EUR','JPY','CHF','AUD','CNY','HKD','NZD','SEK','KRW','SGD','NOK','MXN','INR','DKK','CLF','IDR','CLP','BRL','CAD','MYR','COP','GBP','ARS','RON','RUB','PHP','ILS','PLN','PEN','LTL','LVL','SIT','SAR','ZAR','QAR','CZK','TWD','THB','PKR','TRY','ISK','KWD','AED','JOD','NGN','EGP','HUF','MAD','PGK','MOP','VES','VEF','LKR','BGN','VND','BMD','XOF','BDT','ZMW','KES','HRK','MWK','GHS','MUR','JMD','RSD','TND','KZT','UAH','TTD','OMR','TZS','BWP','UGX','BHD','ZWL','IRR','AZN','BYN','ZWG')

group by business_date, trade_id, future_cashflows_currency ) fcp ON 

CASE 
    WHEN risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure.position_key LIKE 'MX%' THEN SUBSTRING(risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure.position_key FROM 3)
	ELSE risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure.position_key
  END = fcp.trade_id and risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure.exposure_currency  = fcp.future_cashflows_currency and cast(risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure.business_date as date)  = fcp.business_date

WHERE 
risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure.business_date <  '2025-06-06' and
risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure.investment_dept = 'Active Equities' and 
risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure.investment_strategy in ( 'Asia','North America','Europe','LatAm') and
risk_prod.rmv_fx_exposure.product_type not in ('FX Non Deliverable Forward','FX Forward')

) risk_database
group by business_date, exposure_currency, investment_strategy

order by investment_strategy, business_date

with Trans as (
 SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
        order by trans.changed_date desc 
        ) AS rn
    FROM
        trades_deals.scd_transactions trans
    WHERE trans.accounting_framework_id = 'PCLFWKMAIN'
	)
, FINTrans as (
        select
            fin.*,
            row_number() over (
                        partition by fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key  
                        order by fin.extract_time desc
                   ) as rn
        from
            finance_accounting.scd_finance_transactions fin
        where fin.accounting_framework_id = 'MAIN'            
), 
MaxBusinessDates AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_portfolio) AS max_mp_bd,
        (select MAX(business_date) from reference.reference_currency_codes) as max_rcc_bd
)
Select 
trans.trade_date, 
trans.portfolio_id, 
trans.fx_rate_interest_currency_to_portfolio_currency, 
trans.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency, 
trans.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_settlement_currency, 
trans.settlement_date,
trans.transaction_number_in_originating_system, 
trans.abor_transaction_number, 
fintrans.credit_amount_quotation_currency, 
fintrans.credit_amount_portfolio_currency, 
fintrans.debit_amount_quotation_currency, 
fintrans.debit_amount_portfolio_currency, 
fintrans.gl_account_id, 
fintrans.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key, 
trans.forward_current_value_portfolio_currency, 
trans.forward_current_value_quotation_currency, 
fintrans.gl_account_name, 
fintrans.finance_transaction_quotation_currency_name, 
fintrans.abor_finance_account, 
port.portfolio_group_name,
rcc.currency_name
from Trans trans
left join FINTrans fintrans on trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key = fintrans.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key and fintrans.rn = 1
--join TRANS trans on trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key = fintrans.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key and fintrans.rn = 1
left join reference.scd_portfolio port on port.business_date = (select max_mp_bd from MaxBusinessDates) and port.portfolio_id = fintrans.portfolio_id

/* QuickSight 64d081f2-9222-455f-9b4d-44ec348bb0da */
SELECT "business_date", "pool_name", "account_name", "investment_structure_level_01", "investment_structure_level_02", "external_reporting_dm_em", "external_reporting_region", "external_reporting_country", "external_reporting_assetmix", "business_date_string", "year_month", "is_month_end", "is_fiscalyear_end", "external_reporting_dm_em_region", "external_reporting_currency", "total_market_value_pc"
FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, date_add( 'month', 9, mhl.business_date ) as fiscal_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name_unified as pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.external_reporting_dm_em
		, mhl.external_reporting_region
		, mhl.external_reporting_country
		, mhl.external_reporting_assetmix
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from (
		select
			*
			, case -- per request of Doug to use special handling to make pool names consistent over history in short term until they have a long-term fix
				when pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Core Pool' ) then 'Core'
				when pool_name in ( 'Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool' ) then 'Supplementary'
				else pool_name
			  end pool_name_unified
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
	) mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name_unified = unitization.pool_name
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
		and mhl.id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
			  'MIN1000042'
			, 'NPTESTA'
			, 'NPTESTB'
			, 'PMIEMELTCS'
			, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
			, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
			, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
		) 
		and mhl.business_date >= cast( '2019-03-31' as date ) -- only pull from F20 onwards because unitization data only goes back to 2018-10-01
), lt_final as (
	select
		  lt_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case 
			when business_date = ( max( business_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from business_date ), extract( month from business_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_month_end
		, case 
			when fiscal_date = ( max( fiscal_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from fiscal_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_fiscalyear_end
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'CHINA', 'HONG KONG', 'TAIWAN', 'MACAO' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'INDIA' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' then 'Other DM'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case -- temporary logic to coalesce currency of exposure code and parent quoted currency until fix is implemented in LT product
			when coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code ) in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code )
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
	from
		lt_base
), lt_final_agg as (
	select *
	from (
		select
			  lt_agg.business_date
			--, lt_agg.fiscal_date
			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_assetmix
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg.is_month_end
			, lt_agg.is_fiscalyear_end
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			--, lt_agg.total_market_value_pc as total_market_value_pc_orig
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em

FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, date_add( 'month', 9, mhl.business_date ) as fiscal_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name_unified as pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.parent_security_number

		, mhl.external_reporting_assetmix
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from (
		select
			*
			, case -- per request of Doug to use special handling to make pool names consistent over history in short term until they have a long-term fix
				when pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Core Pool' ) then 'Core'
				when pool_name in ( 'Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool' ) then 'Supplementary'
				else pool_name
			  end pool_name_unified
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
	) mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name_unified = unitization.pool_name
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
		and mhl.id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
			  'MIN1000042'
			, 'NPTESTA'

			, 'PMIEMELTCS'
			, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
			, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
			, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
		) 
		and mhl.business_date >= cast( '2019-03-31' as date ) -- only pull from F20 onwards because unitization data only goes back to 2018-10-01

			when business_date = ( max( business_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from business_date ), extract( month from business_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_month_end
		, case 
			when fiscal_date = ( max( fiscal_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from fiscal_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_fiscalyear_end
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'CHINA', 'HONG KONG', 'TAIWAN', 'MACAO' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'INDIA' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' then 'Other DM'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case -- temporary logic to coalesce currency of exposure code and parent quoted currency until fix is implemented in LT product
			when coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code ) in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code )
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
	from
		lt_base
), lt_final_agg as (
	select *
	from (
		select
			  lt_agg.business_date
			--, lt_agg.fiscal_date
			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_assetmix
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg.is_month_end
			, lt_agg.is_fiscalyear_end
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			--, lt_agg.total_market_value_pc as total_market_value_pc_orig
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS
			array [ 'bCPP', 'aCPP' ],
			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )
	)
	where total_market_value_pc is not null and total_market_value_pc != 0

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance_dev.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance_dev.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:

			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency

	select

		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case

			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'

		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (

			  scd.dataset_id

			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance_dev.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance_dev.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot

		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency'

		/* VALUE */

			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency

			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]

	 */

		, case
